exposure: AIH with cirrhosis vs. AIH without cirrhosis
cohort: 309 singleton births in women with AIH and 1532 matched births in women from the general population in Sweden
finding: Maternal autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) was associated with a 5-fold higher odds of preterm birth, and the presence or absence of cirrhosis at diagnosis did not affect this association.
mod_finding: Maternal AIH was linked to an increased odds of cesarean section.
